prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1363; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. The mechanism of injury is plausible for a crash of this kind. Over the course of care the patient attended 29 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this diagnosis, and treatment included manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and progressive range-of-motion work. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the cervical soft tissue injury, including restricted motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness. No prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated or duplicate charges. The patient has shown gradual improvement, with current status and remaining plan to be reassessed at the next scheduled follow-up.
